downgrade() now counts duplicate (endpoint_ref, source_digest) observations and raises an actionable RuntimeError instead of failing on constraint creation. Catalog snapshots are immutable evidence pinned by trust records and profile versions, so consolidating them would destroy authority live profiles still bind; the repo's 355_checkpoint_blob_dedup precedent is followed.

_reconcile_omnigent_bootstrap_once now returns per-leg OmnigentBootstrapReadiness and the maintenance loop derives refresh_images from policies_ready only, so a catalog-only outage no longer re-pulls images on every retry. Covered by test_catalog_outage_does_not_retry_registry_image_refresh and test_image_policy_outage_keeps_retrying_registry_refresh.

OmnigentHarnessCatalogService now accepts observation_overlay and applies it before persist, so synchronize() publishes exactly one immutable overlaid row and readers can never select an overlay-free latest(). The post-persist second write and its observedAt offset were removed. Covered by test_catalog_sync_publishes_only_the_overlaid_observation.

The overlay source digest now hashes the synthetic harness row (including implementation identity) and the synthetic agent identity alongside the prior digest, so a changed overlay produces a new digest. Covered by test_overlay_digest_tracks_synthetic_overlay_authority.
